subject.title: [BUG] OpenAI Codex errors leak into user chat

question: Should #44910 be resolved as parser support for top-level `detail` payloads only, or should OpenClaw also suppress/no-reply unconfigured Codex/provider failures at the routing boundary?
rationale: The parser gap is source-reproducible, but silent discard changes failed-turn diagnostics and provider-routing behavior, which is a product policy decision rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Parser plus routing policy
options.body: Recognize `detail` payloads and define tested behavior for unconfigured-provider failures so raw JSON never reaches user chat while diagnostics remain available elsewhere.

options.title: Parser-only repair
options.body: Accept the narrow PR shape that formats `detail` errors safely, while leaving provider probe suppression for a separate policy issue.

options.title: Close as existing policy
options.body: Document that upstream provider errors may surface as generic user-facing failures and close the silent-discard request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Parser plus routing policy
recommendation.body: Recognize `detail` payloads and define tested behavior for unconfigured-provider failures so raw JSON never reaches user chat while diagnostics remain available elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the best available owner from the history because the unresolved part is user-facing provider-error delivery policy, adjacent to the merged suppression work.
